title: Nisipos, irrigated, Oltenia sands, mid-September
rationale: The Oltenia sand belt is the real identity of this location. grau_toamna, orz_toamna and rapita_toamna all list nisipos in unsuitable_classes and are excluded. secara lists nisipos first in its suitable_classes and is asserted into the top. triticale also lists nisipos as suitable, so it is left free; with irrigation on, secara's drought_tolerance ridicata does not separate it from triticale's medie, so no ordering is asserted.
